t: This Collingwood 50W LED floodlight offers a robust and adaptable lighting solution for outdoor environments. Equipped with an integrated PIR sensor, it enhances security and convenience for various installations. The durable black cast aluminium body is IP65 rated, making it suitable for demanding conditions, including coastal areas, and ideal for illuminating large areas, courtyards, or building exteriors. It provides flicker-free, colour switchable light with variable white temperatures (3000K, 4000K, 6500K) and a wide 120° beam angle for comprehensive coverage. The adjustable and tiltable design ensures precise light direction.
